row:
Hi I am Mel, an animal physiotherapist for horses and dogs, and my passion is the education of dog and horse owners, to provide your animals with the best of rehabilitation care.  For animals young to old, dogs, horses and other animals can all benefit from physiotherapy, whether they have suffered an injury or have undergone surgery, the benefits of physiotherapy are numerous.

Improve range of motion, mobility, reduce pain and the requirement for pain relief medication, improve flexibility, strength and balance, increase muscle strength + more

On my channel you can find plenty of videos and tutorials about equine back health, saddle assessment, core strength, balance, recovery and rehabilitation after surgery + more. 

And of course you will find plenty of other inspirational videos - all around the topic creating a happy pet for life.
